gamefaqs.section: Action Replay Max DS (.duc) Game Save (North America)

format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header (game 'Pokemon diamond', name 'elite four , 3 shinys'), then 8 KiB raw for the 8 KiB EEPROM (exact size)

verified.converted_with: tools/gamefaqs/nds-ards.py IN step0.bin, then tools/gamefaqs/nds-cores.py step0.bin --chip 8192 --stem 'Castlevania - Dawn of Sorrow (USA)' --out DIR: drops the Action Replay header; fits it to the 8192-byte chip (exact size) and writes each core's file

note: Posted on the Pokemon Diamond / Pearl / Platinum page with a Pokemon description, but it is a Castlevania - Dawn of Sorrow save: the Action Replay header's ASCII copy says "castlevania" / "respaldo 1" / "priemer respaldo", and Dawn of Sorrow (USA) shows its file. GameFAQs 13729, 15744 and 14593 are the same file (two in North America, one in Japan). Filed as the USA release, the one it was verified in; nothing in it names a release.
